The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b4a3f530849ff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix S and a sufficiently large finite β. There are R0 = R0(S, β), Cβ < ∞, and κ > 0 with the following property. Let L ≥ R ≥ R0, with L even, and partition ΛL into rectangular cells whose side lengths lie in [R/2, 4R]. If f : ΛL → [−1, 1] has sum zero on every cell, then, for q = R−5/2, b = − log(1 − q), and any spin component a, log * exp  bx X z∈ΛL fzSa z   + ≤ CβbV, x ∈ R, |x| ≤ κ log R. (5.3) Consequently there are Aβ, c > 0 such that the spectral measurement of Df = P z fzSa z in the zero-field state satisfies P  |Df | > AβV log R  ≤ 2e−cbV . (5.4) All bounds are uniform over the indicated partitions and tests.
